description: This Java class, InitializationDatabaseImpl, implements the InitializationDatabase interface and is responsible for populating and initializing various reference data in a Spring-based e-commerce application, such as languages, countries, zones, currencies, merchant stores, and system modules during application startup or setup.

classes.name: InitializationDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing database initialization routines for setting up core reference data and system configurations during application startup or first-time setup.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the database is empty by counting existing language entries.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the database with languages, countries, zones, currencies, sub-references, modules, and merchant info.

methods.name: createCurrencies
methods.description: Creates currency entries based on the predefined currency map in constants.

methods.name: createCountries
methods.description: Creates country entries with descriptions in supported languages.

methods.name: createZones
methods.description: Loads and creates geographic zones from an external JSON configuration.

methods.name: createLanguages
methods.description: Creates language entries based on predefined ISO codes.

methods.name: createMerchant
methods.description: Creates a default merchant store with associated tax class.

methods.name: createModules
methods.description: Loads and creates system integration modules from a JSON configuration.

methods.name: createSubReferences
methods.description: Creates sub-reference entities such as product types.
